rationale: Both independently caught the same strong bug (ARDiffusionModelRunner.execute_model not forwarding diffusion_kv_metadata), but Y additionally recovers the two substantive architectural themes the ground-truth reviewers actually emphasized: consolidating duplicate request-identity validation spread across sched/interface.py and diffusion_model_runner.py (mirroring asukaqaq-s's explicit call to unify validators/exception ownership), and adding local construction-time invariants to the new DTOs (mirroring asukaqaq-s's 'local construction-time invariants' taxonomy and comparing against the sibling #5541 DTOs). X's remaining findings skew toward test-coverage and docstring nits that don't map onto any reviewer concern. Y also ships concrete code-level fixes with Required/Should-fix/Minor triage, giving it an actionability edge, while precision is comparably strong and well-evidenced on both sides.
